name: Iyashite Ageru
source:
Caught up in the middle of a recession with no relief in sight, the only news written about in newspapers are depressing articles about lay offs and bankruptcies. Now the publishing company Ayako has been working for goes bankrupt. She has become a victim of the recession left destitute. On top of that, she has been disowned by her family for breaking her promise to return home after graduating from her vocational college by accepting employment in the city. "If I were to beg for forgiveness, it's not like I couldn't go back to the country, but I have more pride than that. I just can't find any work..."

Being young and innocent, there is one job she can apply for: She can work in a sex shop. Ayako is employed as a sex shop girl for a fashion health club. Can she find the happiness she seeks with her positive attitude? 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030214174425/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/a/iyashite/]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
经济衰退看不到任何缓解迹象，报纸上尽是裁员和破产的消沉报道。彩子工作的出版社也破产了，她成了这场衰退中一无所有的受害者。更糟的是，她违背了职业学校毕业后回乡的承诺，选择在城市就业，因此遭到家人断绝关系。

「要是低头请求原谅，也不是不能回乡下去，可我的自尊不允许。只是我找不到工作……」

年轻又天真的她，仍有一份工作可以申请：去色情商店工作。彩子受雇成为风俗保健会所的服务女。凭借积极的态度，她能找到自己追求的幸福吗？
